intro.text: A lensmaker, astronomer and gemstone expert, and one of Queen Navani Kholin's trusted scholars.

items.text: Nem examined the black sphere that King Gavilar had given to Szeth and found it almost perfect, able to hold Stormlight for a very long time. Navani asked her and Talnah to study it and try it in different fabrials. Both were killed when the sphere caused an explosion in their shared laboratory.
